$comment: Region settings for the zones engine, from Orazio Campoli’s store for the region. Broad: the zones that cover more than a third of the region, left out of the shading so the smaller zones show.

place.subtitle: From Liguria down to one zone

$why: Not an EU PDO or PGI or a US AVA: a country, state, region, group or sub-zone, with no shape of its own in the map data. The places under it that draw stay covered.
